title: LP2-49–51: zero and capital O register
question: Which grid cells are written with digit zero or capital O, and how can their printed shapes be reviewed against the original images?
summary: The wiki transcription has 65 zeroes and seven capital O characters across 70 of 256 cells. Three coordinate-labeled source-pixel contact sheets expose all 72 round marks for review; a manual pass found no definite conflict with those readings.

scope.representation: The current 256-token wiki grid, checked against original 2400 by 3600 page JPEGs at all cells transcribed with 0 or O.
scope.procedure: Census every 0/O character, record its coordinate and one-character alternative, and assemble unscaled source-pixel crops with coordinate labels for a manual visual review. Independently replay the census from structured page records.
scope.parameters: 256 grid cells; 70 cells selected by transcription; 72 round marks, comprising 65 zeroes and seven capital Os; three original page images.
scope.exclusions: Characters transcribed as neither 0 nor O, other lookalike classes, exhaustive blind image recognition, authorial cipher meaning, and all non-base-60 byte interpretations.

finding: The coordinate census and independent parser agree on 70 selected cells and 72 marks. Seven O entries occur at fixed listed coordinates; a manual contact-sheet review found no definite printed-shape conflict with the current readings. Under the conditional base-60 byte rule, replacing any of 60 leading zeroes by O would exceed one byte.
limitations: The contact sheets are manually calibrated crops and were reviewed by one agent, not independently certified by a human. The selection starts from transcription and can miss a round glyph assigned another symbol. The byte argument is conditional on the representation, not proof of the printed mark. PIL/Pillow rendering version can affect exact contact-sheet bytes.
next_steps: Invite image-level review of the coordinate register, then carry any corrected 0/O cell as an explicit variant through dependent grid experiments. Audit other character classes separately.
